title: Criaturas de Neón de Vidrio: Formas de Vida Transparentes en Paisajes Surrealistas
prompt: Transform all subjects (animals/characters/creatures) within the African savanna at sunset and nightfall into surreal lifeforms composed of transparent glass structures and inner neon light. Their bodies refract surrounding light like crystal, with vivid neon colors flowing inside, and emit bright glows into the environment. The scene maintains its original terrain and environment, but the overall lighting is re-rendered based on these glowing creatures, presenting a dreamlike, sci-fi, and brilliantly colorful visual style. The overall atmosphere is surreal, with exquisite details, strong light and shadow, presenting a futuristic wonderland effect.
